Your Car Purchase goal is currently comfortably ahead of schedule. Out of your average monthly savings of ₹32,680.50, the goal requires ₹15,000.00/month, leaving you on track to reach your ₹800,000.00 target by November 14, 2027 (about 14 months away). 

To reach your car goal even faster, you can trim recent spending surges or save an extra amount each month:
• Reduce Dining spending by 25% (saving ₹1,800/month) to reach your goal about 22 days earlier (October 23, 2027).
• Reduce Shopping spending by 25% (saving ₹1,300/month) to reach your goal about 16 days earlier (October 29, 2027).
• Trim Subscriptions by 25% (saving ₹424.25/month) to reach your goal about 5 days earlier (November 8, 2027).

If you were to set aside an extra ₹5,000.00 per month on top of your baseline, your projected completion date accelerates by about 1.8 months to September 19, 2027.

assumptions: Averaged over the last 3 month(s) of recorded transactions (Jun 2026, Jul 2026, Aug 2026).
Assumes discretionary category spending can be voluntarily reduced without penalty.
Only discretionary categories are proposed for reduction; rent, utilities and existing savings contributions are excluded.
Goal impact is priced by the same deterministic cash-flow engine used by the what-if simulator, with no interest, investment return or inflation modelled.
Assumes an additional ₹5,000 is saved every month on top of the ₹32,681/month baseline.
Assumes income and all other spending stay unchanged for the whole horizon.
Excludes investment returns, interest, inflation, taxes and one-off emergencies — none of these are modelled, so the projection is a plain cash-flow estimate, not a forecast.
This is a synthetic planning model for a hackathon demonstration, not regulated financial advice.
